latest_cos_commentary.headline: Dinova is a corporate dining referral/loyalty network linking 24,000+ restaurants to roughly 600 corporate accounts, not a POS or payments platform.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Minimal direct overlap with Genius's core pos/payments/back_office lines; its myDinova points program is loyalty_engagement-adjacent but operates as a network layer above any given restaurant's POS.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Dinova is emphasizing business dining as a growth segment in 2026 amid flat consumer foot traffic, continuing to expand its restaurant partner roster.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Relevant mainly as an ecosystem/referral partner conversation, not a head-to-head POS displacement; no evidence Dinova competes on payments processing.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No current leadership, ownership, or pricing/fee-model information was found in this pass; do not assume Dinova is a payments competitor without further evidence.
